variants.label: Медный
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new original character portrait for the game Duelyant, part of a consistent 20-portrait series.
INPUT IMAGE ROLES: Image 1 is the primary SERIES STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference, an already accepted portrait. Match its framing, hand-painted etched texture, degree of realism, dark background, muted palette, light direction and understated expression, but give the new character a clearly distinct face described below. Images 2–4 are supporting gothic fantasy style references; never copy their costumes, frames, facial identities, pointed ears or supernatural anatomy.
Create a close HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAIT of one living adult androgynous HUMAN. Human ears, normal natural eyes, no beard, no pronounced gender-coded styling, no makeup. Adult age as specified below. All faces belong to the same grounded gothic fantasy world. Show natural organic skin, not stone or metal; healthy with subtle weathering.
Composition: vertical 2:3 preferably 1024x1536, head fully within frame with small margin, eyes about 38–42% down, close-up of head and neck, a plain dark coarse cloth at the very bottom like the primary series reference. Face in three-quarter view turned toward IMAGE RIGHT, both eyes readable. No full body. Same camera distance as the primary reference.
Art direction: textured early gothic fantasy illustration, convincing sculptural face modelling, fine crosshatched/painted surface, strong angular facial planes without geometric polygon facets. Muted organic skin tones with charcoal shadows and ivory or bronze highlights. Single directional light from upper front-left, deep shadows on opposite side. Clean readable eyes, nose and lips. Deep almost black charcoal background with subtle dark teal tonal variation, no landscape.
No frames, lettering, labels, logos, watermarks, jewelry, weapons, armor, headgear, horns, skulls, bright magic, glowing eyes, neon, exaggerated grin, cartoon, anime, glossy plastic CGI, studio photography, or elaborate clothing. ONE portrait only, no contact sheet or multiple heads.
Make the facial structure and hair recognizably different from the reference while keeping the visual rendering style extremely consistent.

NEW CHARACTER: An oval mature adult face, warm copper-brown skin, short curly dark chestnut hair, hazel eyes, slightly arched nose and gently uneven brows. Age 35.
